title: 856. Score After Flipping Matrix

examples.explanation: Rows become 1111, 1001 and 1011 after optimal flips, totaling 39.

hints: The leftmost column carries the largest weight, so first make every entry there a 1 using row flips; that choice never harms optimality.
Once the leading column is fixed, each remaining column can be decided independently by picking the majority value to maximize its contribution.
A column with `c` ones among `m` rows contributes `max(c, m - c) * 2^(n-1-j)` after the optimal column flip.
